title: V5: align RFC16 cluster timing with genesis seal cadence
brief: Fix CY cluster seal_suppressed_by_cluster storm after 1s seal cadence: derive cluster attest/catchup timing from blocks_per_hour; ensure ClusterPropose cadence keeps up with seal gate; no new consensus CLI knobs.

design.root_cause: Seal gate every seal_interval_ms (~1000) but ClusterPropose on heartbeat (~1500ms); attest_timeout_ms=1000 equals one tick

formula_hints.attest_timeout_ms: code-derived e.g. max(2 * seal_interval_ms, seal_interval_ms + 500) — document in code
formula_hints.tx_catchup_ms: derive from seal_interval or wire into cluster path if currently unused

explicit_non_goals: No --seal-interval-ms or new operator cadence CLI
Do not make cluster timing independently tunable via new env flags

acceptance_criteria: When cluster enabled on proposer: attest_timeout_ms and related windows derived at startup from chain GenCfg.blocks_per_hour (same source as seal_interval_ms).
ClusterPropose emission cadence is not slower than seal_interval_ms on healthy proposer (decouple from default 1500ms heartbeat-only path or add seal-aligned propose trigger).
CY soak: scan_pwmd_log_counters shows no sustained missing_round_state/attestations_missing while head advances (startup burst acceptable).
tx_catchup_ms either used in cluster catch-up path OR removed from misleading defaults/docs with comment.
Startup log records derived cluster_attest_timeout_ms, seal_interval_ms, blocks_per_hour.
Unit/integration tests: BPH=3600 timing helpers; cluster gate not starved with mocked round state.
cargo test -p pwmd --lib lifecycle; cargo test -p pwmd --lib peer_session or production cluster tests if touched.
notes: Review REQUEST_CHANGES; owner requires genesis/code-locked consensus timing only.

delegation.invite_note:
Implement 20260529-v5-cy-cluster-attest-suppression-review recommendations.

Read:
- docs/reviews/20260529-v5-cy-cluster-attest-suppression-review.md
- lifecycle::seal_interval_ms (already from blocks_per_hour)
- run_cluster_gate, send_cluster_prop, steady_session heartbeat loop

Fix:
1) Derive cluster_attest_timeout_ms (and tx_catchup if kept) from blocks_per_hour at App init — NOT new CLI.
2) Propose cadence >= seal cadence on cluster proposer (key fix).
3) Tests + runbook update.

Validate: CY 2-node or pwmd production cluster tests; scan suppressions.

Skill: colloquium-cqds-mcp; project_id: 5. Minimal focused diff.
